title: Chapter 314: The Queen Of Insects' Cross-Border Attack
content:
Chapter 314: The Queen Of Insects' Cross-Border Attack

"Buzz......!"

The Queen's terrifying spiritual power seemed to be coming to the battlefield, and the space was shaking!

The strength of the Zerg in the entire Zerg extermination unit was not weak, and with the protection of the Zerg scorpion black bee, the Queen no longer had to worry about it and was ready to give a hard blow to the powerful weird that wanted to show up.

"Crackle......!" The space in the overlapping area of space became more fragile, and there were signs that it was about to break apart.

The space cracks showed different degrees of distortion.

Even though the space fluctuated so violently, the weird in the central area did not suffer any damage from the space force, which somewhat subverted Wu Qing's understanding of the rules of space.

"This overlapping area of space is very strange. I seem to be able to easily break through the space barrier and hit the enemy on the opposite side!"

The Queen suddenly said to Wu Qing.

"Then use some strength and give the opposite side a hard blow!"

Wu Qing was not afraid of destroying this world. The stability of this world was still very good at ordinary times, but at night, the space became unstable in the area outside the protection range of the lord.

"Okay!"

As soon as the Queen of Insects finished speaking, a powerful energy that could destroy the world instantly descended, using 100,000 five-star Zerg hosts as carriers to launch a devastating blow to the opposite side of the space overlap zone!

An invisible and terrible force, like poking through a layer of window paper, broke through the barrier of the world and rushed into the unknown world on the opposite side!

"Ah...!"

An extremely shrill scream came from the opposite space and instantly stopped moving.

This terrible confrontation was clearly felt by people far away in the main city of the Naga desert!

"Someone powerful has taken action! I don't know who the Zerg is fighting against!"

Naga stood on a high place, looking at the direction of the Zerg extermination troops, muttering to herself.

She did not ask Host No. 3, but asked someone to pass the news to the top leaders of the tribe.

...

The Queen of Insects suddenly took action and gave a heavy blow to the powerful weird in the unknown space. The result is unknown, but the powerful weird will at least suffer a heavy blow, which is beyond doubt.

On the battlefield where the Zerg extermination troops fought against the weird, there was no more spying of the powerful weird.

But the overlapping space overlap area will not be restored, a large number of weirds are still rushing through the space cracks, and those strange weirds that ignore the space barrier are constantly appearing out of thin air.

More and more weirds appear, six-star Zerg scorpions and six-star Zerg queens join the battle, the plague area created by the Zerg scorpions and the giant trapping net of the Zerg queen make it difficult for the weird to move.

As time goes by, the space cracks in the space overlap area continue to increase, and all arms of the Zerg extermination troops have joined the battle.

Under the unified command of the queen, each arm exerts its strength to the fullest, and the arms do not interfere with each other.

Thousands of six-star Zerg mammoths, led by ten seven-star Zerg mammoths, gallop freely on the battlefield.

The seven-star and six-star teams of various Zerg arms participating in the battle test are all on their own small battlefields, displaying various powerful abilities.

The seven-star Zerg puppies, Zerg hydralisks, Zerg cockroaches, Zerg destroyers, Zerg stealth spiders, and Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, with their respective six-star teams, kill the weird in their own way.

The strength of the Zerg puppies has been upgraded to seven stars, and its melee ability has reached the extreme. Wherever it passes, any enemy is cut in half, and people can't see the traces of its knife.

The armor-piercing sharp attack of the seven-star Zerg hydralisk will kill any weird with one blow, and no one can escape.

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid it sprays falls on the weird, just like ice and snow melting, and any weird will turn into nothingness.

The flame attack of the seven-star Zerg cockroach, the liquid shell attack of the seven-star Zerg destroyer, the armor-piercing spikes of the seven-star Zerg stealth spider, and the poisonous ray attack of the seven-star Zerg poisonous ray scorpion have all undergone qualitative changes in lethality.

The various attacks of the seven-star arms have already possessed the characteristics of mobilizing the energy of heaven and earth. The attacks assisted by heaven and earth have extremely terrible lethality.

Wu Qing saw the battlefield performance of these high-star Zerg arms, and the Queen of Zerg recorded them in detail.

Wu Qing found that as long as they were strong enough, all Zerg arms could effectively kill the weird. The arms only had different attack methods, but no difference in combat power.

If there are strengths, there must be weaknesses. Each has its own specialties and is suitable for different battlefield environments.

There is no problem with the current arm and force configuration of the Zerg's extermination troops. Of course, there is no problem at all to upgrade all Zerg arms to five stars or above and join this extermination force.

The current arm and force configuration of the Zerg's extermination troops mainly considers the overall mobility of the troops and the convenience of coordinated operations of various arms.

…

The battlefield between the Zerg's extermination troops and the weird is getting bigger and bigger. It seems that the war between the two sides has aggravated the fragility of the overlapping space area, and new space cracks continue to appear on the battlefield.

More and more weird and powerful weird rushed out, and all the seven-star strongmen of the Zerg's extermination troops participated in the battle.

A large number of Zerg Puppies and Type III Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions, which had been on standby in the Ancient Desert Lord's protection area, also rushed out of the Lord's protection area and joined the battlefield.

Zerg Puppies joined the rampaging Zerg Mammoth team, followed behind the Zerg Mammoth, and specifically attacked the plague area created by the Zerg Scorpions.

One hundred seven-star Zerg scorpions and one thousand six-star Zerg scorpions are now using all their strength to turn the entire battlefield into a horrible plague zone. Once the Zerg puppies enter the battlefield, they are equivalent to entering the plague zone.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The Zerg puppies with a large number of troops can also exert their strong combat power in close combat with the strange creatures infected with the plague and whose combat power has been greatly reduced.

The Zerg scorpions that still have spare power simply release black bees to the area where the Zerg puppies attack, and continue to expand the coverage of the black fog.

With the blessing of the black fog, the Zerg puppies can fight all kinds of strange creatures infected with the plague alone.

The melee ability of the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions is not good. They all entered the bottom of the Zerg extermination troops and supported the front operations within the range of the Zerg host's large-scale mental attack.

With the dual protection of the black fog and the Zerg host, the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions can also provide powerful firepower support.

The participation of Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions further expanded the scale of the entire war.

As the war continued, the more weirds appeared, the stronger the average strength of the weirds, and the more seven-star weirds appeared.

Wu Qing was looking forward to the appearance of a powerful eight-star weird.

One thousand and one hundred powerful Zerg scorpions continued to expand the coverage of the black bees and the scope of the plague area, protecting more Zerg puppies to join the battlefield, and continued to strengthen the attack on the weird.

In the early hours of the morning, suddenly a terrifying giant eight-clawed weird squeezed out from a space crack. The powerful momentum was enough to make ordinary troops fall into an indescribable weird state when they saw it.

"Finally a big guy is here!"

The eight-star weird that Wu Qing was waiting for finally appeared!

A well-prepared seven-star Zerg scorpion exerted its elimination ability on the eight-star giant eight-clawed weird that had just squeezed out of the space crack.

The rule-level power was activated to make conditional judgments. If the conditions were established, the elimination effect would take effect!

"Roar...!"

The eight-star giant eight-clawed weirdness that should have disappeared immediately did not disappear immediately. Instead, it twisted its huge body in pain and let out a thunderous roar before it disappeared.

"Kill one!"

Wu Qing felt that the time for the Zerg mother nest to upgrade to eight stars was not far away.

"However, these eight-star weirdnesses are really powerful. They can resist the rule-level power of the seven-star Zerg scorpion!"

"Unfortunately, the Queen of the Zerg, who is no longer afraid of power loss, cannot attack at will!"

Wu Qing has already noticed that with the Queen of the Zerg's power level, she cannot attack at will.

Using the power of the great power in this world will affect the already broken world rules, and the world rules will instinctively reject it.

It's okay to use it occasionally, but if it is used frequently, Wu Qing estimates that some bad things will happen.

For example, the race to which the great power belongs will reduce the level of the world rule authority of the great clan, and may even lose the status of the great clan.

Some powerful people who are too powerful may be rejected by this world and thrown into an unknown place outside the world if they attack frequently.

So after the Queen of Zerg attacked once, she stopped. Unless it was absolutely necessary, the Queen of Zerg would not attack casually.

…

From early morning to dawn, another strange eight-star weird appeared on the battlefield and was successfully killed by the seven-star Zerg scorpion.

The sky finally dawned, and the huge battlefield, which was originally extremely lively, instantly returned to calm.

The space overlap area, which was fragile, quickly returned to normal because of the arrival of daylight, and the space cracks on the battlefield disappeared.

On the battlefield, no matter what state the weird was in, it was like a dream bubble, gradually fading and disappearing.

"Magical world rules!"

Even though he had seen such a scene once, Wu Qing still felt it was magical.

This world can no longer be viewed according to common sense.

The Zerg extermination troops and a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which had fought all night, entered the scope of the ancient desert territory to rest and recover.

In the next few days, the Zerg extermination troops and the Zerg army here will take the initiative to fight the weird at night.

The battle between the Zerg and the Weird ended, and the rewards of the world rules arrived as expected. The large amount of luck rewards and the Weird eliminated in one night made the system resources gradually sufficient again.

The rewards of the battle last night were more than any previous battles, which may have something to do with the Queen of the Zerg's move. The Queen of the Zerg dealt a heavy blow to the Weird strongman in the unknown space.

The Zerg has taken another big step towards the goal of obtaining the status of a great clan.

"Such a big battle, a few more nights, the Zerg mother nest can almost be upgraded to eight stars!"

"Keep fighting, the Zerg's status as a great clan is within reach!"

With the powerful enemy Weird, Wu Qing is full of confidence that the Zerg will quickly gain the status of a great clan.
